adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, after a successful parse it unconditionally injects a placeholder when `refresh_token` is missing: `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (line ~26). In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refreshed token data is merged into the previously stored credentials via `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`, so if the refresh response omits `refresh_token` (common on refresh flows), the placeholder overwrites the real stored refresh token and is then persisted in the subsequent `prisma.credential.update(...)`, breaking future refreshes (e.g., `invalid_grant`).
